topic: NAD+/NMN honest take (rides @DrJesseMorse NAD+ review thread, 8,589 views)
text:
NAD+ and NMN are everywhere right now.

My honest take, as a retired CPA who reads the fine print:
They do raise NAD+ in the blood.
Proof they slow aging in people? Not there yet.

So I treat them like any purchase. Start small, stay steady, and watch for real results.
